title: Evolution Part One: Natural Selection and Extinction
coreMove: Test fitness against the environment that selects, not against abstract strength or past success.
sourcePressure: Natural selection and extinction are framed as differential persistence under environmental pressure, with extinction as the same logic in reverse.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: turning selection into ruthless competition or survival-of-the-strongest slogans
